statement: Mistral OCR 4.1 provides structured blocks, bounding boxes and confidence beyond plain text transcription.
actakit_implication: Good cloud D4 escalation candidate for hard documents.

statement: Provider confidence can be requested at page/block/word granularity.
actakit_implication: Capture it as namespaced QualityEvidence, not global confidence.

statement: Cloud OCR has explicit per-page marginal cost.
actakit_implication: Escalation policy should avoid cloud processing when cheaper local rungs already pass quality gates.

statement: Using the hosted processor sends source material to an external provider.
actakit_implication: Cloud processing must be explicit opt-in with source/privacy policy, egress provenance and retention controls.
